title: Local matrices and coordinates of finite free parameter functions
statement: In the internal-module categories of [def-sfb-free-parameter-evaluation-data], let the rank-$r$ point module be the finite biproduct of $r$ copies of the regular $R$-module, and the local checking model the corresponding biproduct of the regular $p_V^*R$-module. For isomorphisms $e:M\cong B^r$, $e':M'\cong B^s$ and any local linear map $v:M\to M'$, define its matrix by $m_{ij}=\iota_j;e^{-1};v;e';\pi_i\in\operatorname{End}_B(B)$. These are arbitrary local sections, with no point-origin restriction. For a basis $e:p_V^*R^r\cong B^r$, define its derived coordinate map by the canonical exact-pullback/single-complex identification followed by $(e;\pi_i)[0]$. For a local map between pullbacks of finite free point modules, define its derived arrow using the same exact-pullback/single-complex identifications at source and target. Include ranks zero.
